errors.text_span: The bar chart illustrates a comparison of performance scores for various language models on the MATH-500 and AIME24 benchmarks.
errors.evidence: The figure contains six separate bar charts, grouped into two sections (MATH-500 and AIME24), not a single bar chart. This fundamental misinterpretation of the structure leads to numerous subsequent errors.

errors.text_span: labeled “Size (B),”
errors.evidence: The horizontal axis is not labeled. The description hallucinates the label “Size (B).”

errors.text_span: represents the model size in billions of parameters, ordered from smallest (3B) to largest (7B), and utilizes a linear scale ranging from 0 to 95.
errors.evidence: The horizontal axis is a categorical axis showing different models, not a continuous linear scale representing model size. The labels are not consistently ordered by size, and some are labeled "unk". The claim of a linear scale from 0 to 95 is completely false.

errors.text_span: The vertical axis, labeled “Score,”
errors.evidence: The vertical axis is not labeled in the figure. The label "Score" is hallucinated.

errors.text_span: with a scale ranging from 0 to 100
errors.evidence: The y-axis scale is different for the two benchmarks. The MATH-500 charts have a y-axis range from approximately 65 to 100, while the AIME24 charts range from 0 to 90.

errors.text_span: The Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct model is represented by a blue bar
errors.evidence: According to the legend, the Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct model is represented by a blue bar with diagonal lines, not just a blue bar.

errors.text_span: with a score of approximately 95 on both MATH-500 and AIME24
errors.evidence: The Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct model has a score of 78.2 on MATH-500 and 30.0 on AIME24, not approximately 95 on both.

errors.text_span: the Llama-3.1-405B-Instruct model is depicted by a red bar
errors.evidence: According to the legend, the Llama-3.1-405B-Instruct model is represented by a green bar, not a red bar.

errors.text_span: with a score of approximately 97.3 on MATH-500 and 95.2 on AIME24.
errors.evidence: The Llama-3.1-405B-Instruct model scored 71.4 on MATH-500 and 23.3 on AIME24. The values 97.3 and 95.2 belong to different models (DeepSeek-R1 and DeepSeek-R1-Distill-7B, respectively) on the MATH-500 benchmark.

errors.text_span: The DeepSeek-R1-Distill-1.5B model is shown by a purple bar
errors.evidence: According to the legend, the DeepSeek-R1-Distill-1.5B model is represented by a red-brown bar with diagonal lines, not a purple bar.

errors.text_span: achieving a score of 90.8 on MATH-500 and 95 on AIME24.
errors.evidence: The DeepSeek-R1-Distill-1.5B model scored 91.6 on MATH-500 and 63.3 on AIME24, not 90.8 and 95.

errors.text_span: The DeepSeek-R1-Distill-7B model is represented by a green bar
errors.evidence: According to the legend, the DeepSeek-R1-Distill-7B model is represented by an orange bar with diagonal lines, not a green bar.

errors.text_span: attaining a score of 79.8 on MATH-500
errors.evidence: The DeepSeek-R1-Distill-7B model scored 95.2 on MATH-500, not 79.8. The value 79.8 belongs to the DeepSeek-R1 model on the AIME24 benchmark.

errors.text_span: The o1-mini model is represented by a teal bar
errors.evidence: According to the legend, the o1-mini model is represented by a pink bar, not a teal bar.

errors.text_span: with a score of 74.6 on MATH-500 and 71.4 on AIME24
errors.evidence: The o1-mini model scored 90.0 on MATH-500 and 63.6 on AIME24. The values 74.6 and 71.4 belong to other models (GPT-4o and Llama-3.1-405B-Instruct) on the MATH-500 benchmark.

errors.text_span: the o1-preview model is depicted as a golden bar
errors.evidence: According to the legend, the o1-preview model is represented by a brown bar. The 'golden' (tan) bar represents DeepSeek-R1.

errors.text_span: scoring 63.6 on MATH-500 and 66.3 on AIME24.
errors.evidence: The o1-preview model scored 85.5 on MATH-500 and 44.6 on AIME24. The value 63.6 belongs to o1-mini on AIME24, and 66.3 is not present in the chart at all.

errors.text_span: The o1 model is shown as a sky blue bar
errors.evidence: According to the legend, the o1 model is represented by a grey bar, not a sky blue bar.

errors.text_span: with a score of 79.2 on MATH-500
errors.evidence: The o1 model scored 94.8 on MATH-500, not 79.2. It scored 79.2 on AIME24.

errors.text_span: the DeepSeek-R1 model is depicted as a coral bar
errors.evidence: According to the legend, the DeepSeek-R1 model is represented by a tan ('golden') bar. The coral/orange bar represents DeepSeek-R1-Distill-7B.

errors.text_span: with a score of 44.6 on AIME24 and 83.3 on MATH-500.
errors.evidence: The DeepSeek-R1 model scored 79.8 on AIME24 and 97.3 on MATH-500. The values 44.6 and 83.3 belong to other models (o1-preview and DeepSeek-R1-Distill-7B) on the AIME24 benchmark.
The description fails to mention that some bars have a diagonal line pattern fill while others are solid, a key feature explained in the legend (TTS vs. CoT).
The description does not mention the small icons (e.g., Meta, OpenAI, whale logos) that are placed on top of each bar.
